pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify cart totals before confirming saved cart
lesson.when: A customer asks to save or confirm a cart containing specific items whose prices or SKUs have not been verified through search and pricing tools in the evidence
lesson.do: Perform catalog search and pricing lookup to verify the specific product details and total price before acknowledging the saved cart contents and total
lesson.otherwise: State uncertainty about the unverified items and price details instead of confirming the unverified cart contents or total
